question: Can the observed errors of the current model predict which untried encoder is worth a supervised experiment, even when unsupervised similarity alone failed?
intervention: Within the legal explore actions returned by the current decision policy, rank all unseen encoders by agreement between their normalized pair-difference kernel and the signed probability residuals of the currently elected single or pair. Use at most 256 independently grouped feedback examples, one per group selected by a label-free content hash. Drop diagonal entries before normalization. Ties use the unmodified action ranking. The residual is the true class-one indicator minus the incumbent probability obtained only on its feedback groups. No fitted classifier or external labels are needed to calculate these diagnostic scores.
evaluation: Use the ten independently identified archived representations and both training fidelities from the geometry study. Repartition the primary training holdout into two group-disjoint roles via SHA256('B residual role v1/'+group). Rotate roles, and for every starting pair of actually measured models compare the ordinary next explore action against one chosen by residual agreement. After that single exploration reveal its archived real predictions on the feedback role, elect a single or equal pair on that role with the existing research evaluator, and only then measure the other role. Compare 45 overlapping starts per role. No sum of corrected examples across counterfactuals will be presented as unique questions.
gate: A further ordinary solve is warranted only when both training sizes show an average held improvement of at least 0.25 percentage points, at least 10% of next actions change, and neither rotated role has negative mean improvement. Otherwise retain the existing policy. A passing result requires an independently held-out task before deployment.
budget: Zero new supervised fits, zero model API. Only previously recorded Task2 training predictions and frozen representations. No designated validation, official test, Arctic outer panel, movie scoring labels or H2.
